subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser automation improvement should OpenClaw core/plugin own next: model-visible state signals, CDP element inspection, post-fill verification, or model-advertised batch actions?
rationale: Current code already implements parts of the report, but the remaining requests change model-facing browser semantics and should not be chosen by cleanup automation from one broad field report.

options.title: Scope state-signal slice
options.body: Prioritize stale-ref/readiness/CAPTCHA signaling and document how agents should react before adding more action shapes.

options.title: Advertise existing batch first
options.body: Expose the already-supported batch action shape in the browser tool schema and docs as a narrow follow-up.

options.title: Split and defer diagnostics
options.body: Break CDP inspection and post-fill verification into separate product issues so each can be reviewed with its own safety and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Scope state-signal slice
recommendation.body: Prioritize stale-ref/readiness/CAPTCHA signaling and document how agents should react before adding more action shapes.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest recent history on the browser action route and the merged selector/batch PR related to the report.
